reference.title: All Settings review states
reference.shortdesc: Use this reference to interpret clean, invalid, CIS manual-review, raw, unknown, deprecated, and imported review states.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Review states explain why All Settings asks for attention before the user edits routine values.

section.title: Clean profile
section.p: A clean profile has no remaining Review items. It can still contain configured settings; it simply has no attention states that BPM can detect.

section.title: Invalid items
section.p: Invalid items have values that fail current validation for the selected schema channel and should be fixed or removed before handoff.

section.title: CIS manual review
section.p: CIS manual-review items need a human decision or external verification. BPM can surface the item without claiming certified compliance.

section.title: Raw, unknown, and imported items
section.p: Raw fallback, unknown, and imported items should be preserved or removed deliberately because BPM may not be able to model their intent visually.

section.title: Deprecated items
section.p: Deprecated settings may still exist in a profile, but the user should confirm current Release/ESR support before relying on them.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If a state is unexpected, clear filters, confirm the schema channel, refresh the profile, and inspect the setting detail before editing.
